summary: Sprint 26 testing: (1) Dedicated Aprobaciones Pendientes page + sidebar badge, (2) Resend email notifications on submit-approval (docs) and submit-closure (audits). Backend + frontend both pass end-to-end against production preview URL.
passed_tests: Backend: POST /api/documents/{id}/submit-approval sets approval_status=pending, adds submitted_at/by, and triggers async _notify_approvers. Log confirms 'Approval notification: sent to 1/3 approvers for company default' and 'Email sent to stephaniaceballosmendoza@gmail.com: Aprobacion pendiente: TEST_IT26_doc'. The 2 failures (admin@sgsst.test, etc.) are Resend free-tier sandbox restrictions (expected behavior).
Backend: GET /api/approvals/pending returns {documents, audits, total}. Count correctly incremented from 1 to 2 after submit, and decremented back to 1 after POST /api/documents/{id}/approve.
Backend: POST /api/documents/{id}/approve records approval_history with 'submitted' + 'approved' entries, sets approval_status=approved, approved_by, approved_at.

Backend: _notify_approvers helper queries db.users with role in [admin, owner, sgsst_manager] + active!=false + (company_ids includes cid OR email=OWNER_EMAIL), excludes submitter. Verified via log count 3 approvers found for default company.
Backend: submit-closure email log also shows 'Approval notification' entry from prior test runs (log line at 14:17:38 from admin@sgsst.test rejection + stephania success).
Frontend ADMIN sidebar: data-testid=sidebar-nav-approvals present with text 'Aprobaciones' + badge data-testid=sidebar-badge-approvals showing count '1' matching /api/approvals/pending total.

Frontend ADMIN /approvals page: h1 'Aprobaciones Pendientes' with counter badge, tab-documents shows 'Documentos (1)', tab-audits shows 'Auditorias (0)', pending doc card data-testid=pending-doc-doc_0c525384 with approve-doc-*/reject-doc-*/detail-doc-* buttons all present.
Frontend ADMIN reject dialog: opens with reject-reason-input textarea + confirm-reject-btn button.
Frontend ADMIN detail modal: opens via detail-doc-* button showing document info.

Frontend sgsst_manager: sidebar-nav-approvals NOT present (gated by canManageCompanies which is admin/owner only, per code review). However direct /approvals URL DOES load the approvals-page (backend RBAC correctly allows sgsst_manager).
Frontend auditor: sidebar-nav-approvals NOT present (correct, not an approver for this scope).
action_items: Consider: Layout.js gates 'Aprobaciones' nav by canManageCompanies (admin/owner only), but sgsst_manager IS a valid approver per backend RBAC. Consider adding a dedicated canApprove flag (admin/owner/sgsst_manager) so sgsst_manager gets the sidebar link. Currently they must type /approvals manually. Not a bug per agent-to-agent context note but a UX improvement.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L69-91 _notify_approvers: correct query (role in admin/owner/sgsst_manager, active!=false, company_ids match OR owner_email), excludes submitter via exclude_email, logs sent/total count. Uses db.users.find projection {_id:0,email:1,name:1,role:1} - good for performance.
server.py L943 & L1330: asyncio.create_task(_notify_approvers(...)) is non-blocking which is correct for submit-approval/closure - the API returns immediately and email sends in background. Good UX.
server.py L906-944 submit_document_approval: uses require_role('admin','sgsst_manager') - correct gating. Records approval_history properly.

Approvals.js: clean component, uses data-testids consistently (approvals-page, tab-documents, tab-audits, pending-doc-*, approve-doc-*, reject-doc-*, detail-doc-*, reject-reason-input, confirm-reject-btn). Reject dialog validates non-empty reason. Auto-refresh via fetchPending() after approve/reject.
Approvals.js L30: initial fetch only on mount - no polling. Sidebar badge polls separately (per problem statement every 60s from Layout.js).
Layout.js (per review_request L72): gates Aprobaciones nav by admin/owner only. Recommend extending to sgsst_manager since backend allows them.

success_rate.backend: 100% (submit/pending/approve flow verified + email log confirms sent to 1/3)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 4 role sidebars + admin /approvals page + dialogs verified)

seed_data_creation: Created doc_da47319f (TEST_IT26_doc, approved in same run, no cleanup needed). Preexisting pending doc doc_0c525384 (TEST_rej_*) used for UI verification.

Backend logs correctly show '1/3 approvers' due to Resend free-tier sandbox (only stephaniaceballosmendoza@gmail.com delivered; admin@sgsst.test etc. rejected by Resend API - expected per problem statement). Sidebar nav for sgsst_manager is hidden by design (canManageCompanies gate in Layout.js L72) but direct URL /approvals works - optional UX improvement flagged in action_items.
